BETA Close X Hikma Pharmaceuticals Plc has announced the repurchase of 34,554 ordinary shares between June 22, 2026, and June 26, 2026, as part of its $250 million share buyback program. These shares were acquired at prices ranging from 1,469.00 to 1,476.00 pence, with a volume-weighted average price of 1,473.17 pence for the XLON trading venue. The company intends to cancel these repurchased shares, and since the program's inception on February 26, 2026, a total of 9,666,177 shares have been bought back for £130,823,465.52. Following these transactions and cancellations, Hikma will have 212,220,276 ordinary shares in issue. Disclaimer* Hikma Pharmaceuticals Plc 29 June 2026 HIKMA PHARMACEUTICALS PLC TRANSACTIONS IN OWN SHARES Hikma Pharmaceuticals PLC (LSE: HIK) (NasdaqDubai: HIK) (LEI: 549300BNS685UXH4JI75) (the '' Company '') announces that, during the period from 22 June 2026 to 26 June 2026 (inclusive) (the '' Disclosure Period ''), it purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 10 pence each through J.P. Morgan Securities plc as part of the second tranche (which commenced on 27 May 2026) of its $250 million share repurchase programme announced on 26 February 2026 (the '' Buyback Programme ''). Since the launch of the Buyback Programme on 26 February 2026, the Company has purchased a total of 9,666,177 ordinary shares at a total cost of £130,823,465.52. The Company holds 12,833,233 of its ordinary shares in treasury. Following the settlement of the above transactions and cancellation of the repurchased shares, the Company will have 212,220,276 ordinary shares in issue (excluding treasury shares) and the total number of voting rights in the Company will therefore be 212,220,276.
